title: An inspection and a follow-up visit
titleZh: 區分原驗查與再次到場
passage:
If the inspection report says no further visit is needed, should I tell the tenants the inspection was called off?
A. The report is in the folder with the earlier notices.
B. The inspector asked for a photo after leaving yesterday. There’s no need for her to come back.
C. We called the tenants before the appointment was put on the calendar.
passageZh:
如果驗查報告說不必再次到場，我應該跟住戶說驗查取消了嗎？
A. 報告和之前的通知一起放在資料夾裡。
B. 驗查員昨天離開後請我們補一張照片，不必再回來。
C. 預約登記到行事曆前，我們已經先打電話給住戶。
